Reasoning: The problem gives N1=1000, N2=500, u1=3+4√2 sin(314t−60°) V. The transformer induces the secondary voltage only according to the AC component, so take u1_ac=4√2 sin(314t−60°) V. Since the reference direction of the primary voltage is from the corresponding terminal to the non-corresponding terminal, while the reference direction of the secondary voltage is from the non-corresponding terminal to the corresponding terminal, the signs are opposite, so u2=−(N2/N1)u1_ac=−(500/1000)·4√2 sin(314t−60°)=−2√2 sin(314t−60°). Also because −sin(314t−60°)=sin(314t+120°), u2=2√2 sin(314t+120°) V. Therefore the coefficient in the blank is 2.
